price_list_items_variant_key.name: price_list_items_variant_key
price_list_items_variant_key.where: "price_list_items"."variant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "price_list_items"."deleted_at" IS NULL

role_assignments_scope_check.name: role_assignments_scope_check
role_assignments_scope_check.value: ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'tenant' AND "role_assignments"."scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("role_assignments"."scope_type" IN ('brand', 'outlet', 'station') AND "role_assignments"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL)

roles_template_check.name: roles_template_check
roles_template_check.value: ("roles"."is_template" AND "roles"."template_key" IS NOT NULL AND "roles"."template_key" <> 'super_admin') OR (NOT "roles"."is_template" AND "roles"."template_key" IS NULL)
